Cum explică principiul lui Huygens difra: How does Huygens’s principle explain diffraction?
Difracția este răspândirea undei dincolo: Diffraction is the spreading of a wave beyond the edges of an opening or obstacle, including into the geometrical shadow. Every point of the wavefront reaching the slit becomes a secondary source, starting in phase here. The screen blocks the rest of the wavefront.
Undele secundare se suprapun: în unele d: The secondary wavelets overlap: they reinforce in some directions and weaken in others. Green wavefronts are equal-phase loci of their sum. A simple tangent to the semicircles does not explain the amplitude distribution; diffraction also requires interference.

Pentru a < λ, primul minim nu există în: For a < λ, no first minimum exists in the forward half-plane.
Pentru a = λ, primul minim este la 90°,: For a = λ, the first minimum is at 90°, at the edge of the half-plane.
Fantă mai lată: primul minim se apropie: Wider slit: the first minimum moves towards the axis and the central maximum narrows.
Model scalar bidimensional: fantă unifor: Two-dimensional scalar model: uniformly illuminated slit, homogeneous medium, coherent sources and linear superposition.
